 Nick McPheat, George O'Neill, Jack Herrall & Cal Gilkinson
 Most recent Most popular 'McGinn doesn't attack it' published at 20:31 GMT 20:31 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 James McFadden 
Former Scotland forward on BBC Scotland 
 It's a huge chance.
 Great cross from Robertson and a great header from Patterson at the back post.
 It's so safe from John McGinn, he doesn't really go and attack it.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:30 GMT 20:30 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 That's a huge chance for John McGinn, who's in acres in the box and meets Nathan Patterson's header back across.
 But the Scotland midfielder's own header is so, so tame and straight at the keeper.
 7 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'You've got to feel for Hickey' published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Scott Brown 
Former Scotland captain on BBC Scotland 
 Hickey had been playing so well, I was just literally talking about his positivity running in behind. 
 You've got to feel for him. He'll be disappointed as well because he'll be wanting to prove to everyone he can play the games too. 
 34 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Ferguson won't want to see this back... published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Media caption, Lewis Ferguson won't want to see this one back...
 28 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Nathan Patterson will replace Aaron Hickey, who is straight down the tunnel.
 28 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Ouch! published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Oh dear, Aaron Hickey is clutching his hamstring and he's doing the substitute signal to the bench.
 That's absolutely gutting for the Brentford man. The lad can't catch a break.
 26 81 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:23 GMT 20:23 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Don’t think there is any bigger contrast in Scottish football than going from John McGlynn’s Falkirk to watching the national team just now. I, for one, am looking forward to club football returning.
 Nathan 
 A disagreement in our house, but I would have Christie ahead of Ferguson with his attacking ability. 
A moot point though. As Scotland are once again the cause of their own downfall. Hopeless. 
 Lisa 
 102 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Isaac Schmidt flings himself at a cross, attempting a diving header.
 He's nowhere near it in the end. Quite funny, actually. 
 35 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 A much-changed Switzerland still aren't putting too much pressure on Scotland, if any.
 There's a chance for Sebastien Pocognoli's men to earn a decent result here, even if it'll mean little.
 44 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:17 GMT 20:17 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Remo Freuler attempts an ambitious one from range and it's way off target.
 Meanwhile, Slovenia have just scored in North Macedonia.
 *sighs*
 Ah well, at least GTA is out on Thursday.
 96 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Scotland shoot themselves in foot again' published at 20:14 GMT 20:14 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Scotland winger on Sportsound 
 Porteous was there ready to clear the ball. There's no danger there whatsoever. Scotland have a real habit of shooting themselves in the foot. 
 Lewis Ferguson can't believe he's done that, his centre-back was ready to clear the ball. 
 Image source, SNS 
 126 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Great response' published at 20:13 GMT 20:13 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 James McFadden 
Former Scotland forward on BBC Scotland 
 Great response, great cross from Andy Robertson.
 The keeper is scrambling across, but it is always going wide.
 That is the response Scotland need though.
 80 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:13 GMT 20:13 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 What a great goal from Scotland... Shame it was in the wrong net.
 Len 
 Typical Scottish display of legs going like the clappers to achieve nothing. 
 Peter 
 197 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 20:12 GMT 20:12 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 Wing-back to wing-back, with Andy Robertson's cross finding the head of Aaron Hickey, who is so close to nodding Scotland back on level terms.
 Good response.
 96 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'A blow for Scotland' published at 20:11 GMT 20:11 GMT 
 Switzerland 1-0 Scotland 
 James McFadden 
Former Scotland forward on BBC Scotland 
 Ferguson's trying to get back in, he sticks a leg out.
 Angus Gunn is helpless. 
 For all the positivity and good play, it is a blow. No doubt about that.
 95 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL Switzerland 1-0 Scotland published at 20:10 GMT 20:10 GMT 
 Lewis Ferguson (own goal) 
 An absolute nightmare after starting so well.
 A cross that looks pretty harmless bounces in from the right and Lewis Ferguson just throws a leg at it, poking the ball past his own goalkeeper.
 Media caption, Ferguson's own goal opens scoring for Switzerland
 360 409 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:09 GMT 20:09 GMT 
 Meanwhile, it's goalless in North Macedonia.
 Slovenia haven't had a shot in the opening 20 minutes.
 46 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:07 GMT 20:07 GMT 
 Switzerland 0-0 Scotland 
 Luke Graham has barely put a foot wrong since being thrown into the starting XI on Friday.
 He's started really well again here, the Stoke defender.
 79 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:05 GMT 20:05 GMT 
 Switzerland 0-0 Scotland 
 Scotland look so much more cohesive in their pressing game.
 They get it spot on again and force the Swiss to play long and the visitors have possession back.
 A neat move fails to end with a chance, though, before John McGinn fires off target. 
 Image source, SNS 
 67 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Exciting, end-to-end game' published at 20:03 GMT 20:03 GMT 
 Switzerland 0-0 Scotland 
 Scott Brown 
Former Scotland captain on BBC Scotland 
 It's been really exciting, both teams are very open. 
 I think the two teams are cancelling themselves out, but there's going to be a lot of opportunities in an end-to-end game.
